findings.evidence: The confirmed signature is `lemma upperTriRep_coe_matrix (hp : 0 < p) (b : Fin p)`; `b.isLt : b.val < p` entails `0 < p`.
findings.fix: Remove `hp` from the signature and derive `0 < p` internally from `b.isLt`.
findings.issue: `upperTriRep_coe_matrix` unnecessarily requires `hp : 0 < p`; the argument `b : Fin p` already implies this.

findings.evidence: The confirmed signature is `lemma upperTriRep_last_mul_mapGL_T (b : Fin p) (hb : b.val + 1 = p) (hp : 0 < p)`; either `b : Fin p` or `hb` suffices to establish positivity.
findings.fix: Drop `hp` and derive positivity internally from `b.isLt`, using the generalized `upperTriRep_coe_matrix`.
findings.issue: `upperTriRep_last_mul_mapGL_T` likewise exposes a redundant `hp : 0 < p` alongside `b : Fin p`.

summary: Two matrix lemmas expose redundant positivity assumptions already implied by an inhabitant of `Fin p`.
